catalog_omissions: Native source uses SMA5>=SMA200 despite comment bearish; do not reverse

execution.ambiguity: Stop first when both intrabarlevels reachable and open between; exact path unknown; no limitfill proof
execution.limitations: assumed full fills; no historical orderbook/lot/minnotional/partial fills/PIT tradability; 5mopen proxy
execution.pending: only evaluation signals; delay1or2 bars; stale entry while long ignored; no orders after end

proxy_changes.entry: Original GTC limit replaced by guaranteed nextopen fractional purchase, adverse2bps
proxy_changes.roi: Full OHLC threshold/gap execution assumed; no native order queue
proxy_changes.signal_exit: Original GTC limit replaced by guaranteed nextopen sell, adverse2bps
proxy_changes.stop: Original limit stop replaced by market-style gap/threshold full fill

sequence: due signal exit at rawopen if no conflicting entry and profit-only rawfee gate passes
flat entry due from previous closedbar; never same-bar reentry after sale
open<=stop triggers stop gap; else open>ROI strict gap
low<=stop before high>ROI; risk exits unaffected by signal profit gate
mark remaining position at rawclose; no terminal forced sale
execution.terminal: no forced sale for strategy or buyhold; raw final close mark; unrealized exit costs excluded

rules.source_signal_rules: Entry SMA5>=SMA200 and nativeRSI14<40mRSI14-20; exit nativeRSI14>10mRSI14 and>40mRSI14. Source comment bearish does not reverse SMA comparison. ffill only, no backfill.

source_specific_requirements.higher_timeframes: Derive only10m/40m from held native5m. Original resampled_merge availability is high-open+interval-5m native open, usable only after that5m closes. Preserve source ffill and NaN; no backfill or early incomplete bucket.
source_specific_requirements.rules: Entry SMA5>=SMA200 AND native RSI14<40m RSI14-20; exit native RSI14>10m RSI14 AND >40m RSI14. Preserve source comparison despite its bearish comment.
source_specific_requirements.validation: Independent complete-group OHLCV/WilderRSI and all-row availability; original and shared feature bridge/prefix/future tests; first valid derived RSI indices29/119, SMA200 index199 on aligned fixture.
